# Code of Conduct

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions and the
[Discord server](https://dsc.gg/er-saveman).

- Be respectful. Criticize code and ideas, not people.
- No harassment, insults, slurs or personal attacks.
- No spam, advertising or off-topic flooding.
- Do not share other people's private information.
- Do not post cheats for online play, or ask for help getting around bans.

Report problems on the [Discord server](https://dsc.gg/er-saveman).

Breaking these rules can get comments removed and people blocked from the
repository or banned from the Discord server.
